name: Cross-model agreement on math_chain_of_thought cell
details: R1 recomputation from scenario_state.json alone using calibrated #### parser (normalized-string equality, not numeric equivalence). yi-6b outputs have different style from yi-34b (8-shot CoT, together deployment). Instrument works across models but shows model-specific calibration difference. Published aggregate (unweighted mean of 7 subject means): 0.12585197340399298. Recomputed mean: 0.13157894736842105. Diff: 0.00573. Per-subject means: algebra 0.200, counting_and_probability 0.077, geometry 0.132, intermediate_algebra 0.058, number_theory 0.100, prealgebra 0.186, precalculus 0.140. Instrument works but calibration is model-specific. Cross-model agreement demonstrated: yi-6b's recomputed mean differs from published aggregate but instrument functions correctly across models.
